cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline AI debugging agent that explains code errors and tracks recurring mistakes — built for African developers on low-end hardware with no internet access.

test_prompts.prompt: I am getting this Python error: IndexError: list index out of range at line 12. My code is: items = ['a','b','c'] and then print(items[3]). Explain what caused this error and how to fix it.
Explain what a NullPointerException means in Java and write a simple code example that causes one, then show the fix.
